title.rendered: Budget Reductions Identified for the 2023-24 School Year

content.rendered:
On Wednesday April 12, 2023, District staff shared with the Budget Committee and the Board of Directors a list of budget reductions identified for the 2023-24 school year, including staff layoffs. The reductions were discussed at both the Budget Committee Orientation Meeting as well as the Board of Directors Regular Meeting later that evening. To view these presentations, please see videos below. For the list of identified budget reductions, please see presentation slide deck link below.

Budget Committee Orientation (Reductions discussion begins at approximately 49:54 mark in video)

Board of Directors Regular Meeting (Reductions discussion begins at approximately 1:53 mark in video)
